messages:
Maria CS: Quick thread — need final alignment on CedarLane Health credit matrix for renewal. Renewal call Friday. They're asking for formal uptime/latency credit table and a short explanation of root causes for last quarter's blips. Anyone have the consolidated numbers and a proposed credit schedule? @Sam AE @Ben Platform :eyes:

Sam AE: I can push back on credits in the call but we need concrete numbers. They expect 99.9% uptime and p95 < 1200ms for generation. We had 3 small incidents in Q4 during onboarding traffic spike; want to avoid open-ended credits.

Ben Platform: Putting numbers here from infra dashboards — last quarter (Jan-Mar) CedarLane served on Hosted US-WEST:

```
Uptime: 99.86% (total downtime 10m)
P95 latency (text gen): 1.05s
P99 latency: 2.8s
Major incidents: 2 small infra restarts (5m, 2m), 1 model hot-restart (3m)
```

Li Eng: Cause summary: one autoscaler misconfig during a burst (fixed), one GPU driver OOM during model rollout (rolled back). Both fixed in playbook. We also added prefix caching which helped tail latency after rollout.

Maria CS: Thanks. Propose credit matrix draft:

```
>=99.9% uptime: 0% credit
99.7% - 99.9%: 5% monthly credit
99.0% - 99.7%: 15% monthly credit
<99.0%: 25% monthly credit
P95 <= 1200ms: no latency credit
P95 1200-2000ms: 5% credit
P95 > 2000ms: 15% credit
```

Sam AE: That looks reasonable. Could we add an onboarding carve-out for the first 30 days? They had some onboarding traffic skew that triggered autoscaler issues. If we add a 30-day onboarding exception, legal might accept lower credits.

Ben Platform: We can include a 30-day onboarding exception in the SLO doc. Also we can offer "operational remediation" commit: 2 free deep-dive hours + postmortem + one week monitoring retention increase. Might reduce need for credits.

Maria CS: Action items: 1) @Ben Platform — export CSV of uptime per month + incident IDs by EOD (1967777900). 2) @Li Eng — short root-cause bullets for the customer-facing postmortem (due 1967778000). 3) @Sam AE — proposal to offer onboarding carve-out + remediation in renewal deck (due before Friday call). I'll draft the credit table into the SLA doc and share.

incident-bot: Incident created: CL-2026-03-11-044 — GPU driver OOM during model rollout — severity 2 — assigned eng-oncall

Maria CS: Great, thanks all. I'll iterate and ping for sign-off. :thumbsup:

Sam AE: +1

Ben Platform: +1
